items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Like we play at the festival, and I used Julius Schroenberg on bass, he asked me when we start.

ctx.x: Maybe I knew it's just you.

Yeah, it's a feeling, I don't know. It's how I'm feeling at the particular time, you know. I try to surround myself with some of the better players, you know, make it come out. I've never had any problems. I've always gotten along with different people that I play with, and everybody plays different. You try to be able to capture what's around you, you know, whatever group or whoever the you're playing with, you're playing with at the time. Yeah. And a lot of times it's like really unroiced because the guys know…
What is that commonality that New Orleans drummers have? That separates from? I don't know.
